decisions.question: M172-AM: abutting-lot facts read from the neighbour relation
decisions.recommendation: Amend M-172(2): where parcel_abutments (Spec 130) holds the neighbour, the abutting-lot facts (neighbouring lot is a park, a lane, holds a building) are read from it; where it does not, they stay site facts the user can supply. Rule text: Abutting-lot facts are read from the Spec 130 neighbour relation where it holds the neighbour, and remain user-supplied site facts where it does not (amends M-172(2)).
